description: Boot sequence checked ~/Downloads/transcript-staging/ for staged files but did not spawn Knox or run the full plaud-ingest workflow (steps 01-05). Only a manual staging directory listing was performed. 49 Plaud transcripts (Dec 2025 – May 28, 2026) remained uningested in staging. The boot protocol in CLAUDE.md explicitly requires running the plaud-ingest workflow, not just checking for files.
correction: Boot must spawn Knox as a background Agent with the full plaud-ingest workflow (workflows/plaud-ingest/workflow.md). Checking staging manually is not a substitute. The workflow runs the fetch script (step-04), performs calendar cross-reference (step-03), writes vault notes (step-05), and cleans staging. A directory listing does none of these.
systemic_fix: Added explicit gate to boot sequence: Phase 2 task E (Plaud ingest) must be logged as 'completed' or 'nothing to surface' after Knox agent returns — not after a manual staging check. Boot cannot mark Plaud ingest done without Knox having run the workflow.
fix_description: Added enforcement gate to CLAUDE.md Phase 2 boot sequence after the task table. Explicitly states that manual staging check does NOT satisfy Task E — Knox must be spawned as a background Agent running the full 5-step workflow.
